errors.text_span: 压力组计数组合的标准差
errors.evidence: The figure and reference indicate the chart is about the historical change of a metric over time (caption: 搭配组数标准差的历时变化), not specifically "压力组计数组合的标准差"; this term is not present in the visual or reference.

errors.text_span: x轴包含年份，从1946年开始，以5年为间隔，到2018年
errors.evidence: The x-axis uses year ticks every 2 years from 1946 to 2018, not 5-year intervals.

errors.text_span: y轴表示标准差的数值，刻度采用从-10到60的线性比例
errors.evidence: The y-axis in the figure ranges from -10 to 70, not -10 to 60.

errors.text_span: 在图表线的起始端，标准差约为8
errors.evidence: The solid blue line starts near 0 in 1946, not around 8.

errors.text_span: 在1952年，标准差在约30左右达到一个峰值
errors.evidence: The solid line peaks around 65 in the early 1950s (around 1953), not 30 in 1952.
Around 1960 the solid line is closer to about 10, with local fluctuations; 15 is not the plotted value there.
The solid line around 1970 is much higher, near 40, not about 10.
Around 2008 the plotted values are near 0, not 15.

errors.text_span: 然后于2016年左右稳定在约6
errors.evidence: By 2016 the solid line is near 0, not around 6.

errors.text_span: 在一条虚线中，压力组计数组合的标准差在1946-1950年从8到约30波动
errors.evidence: The dotted trend line starts near 0 in 1946 and rises to about 30 in the early 1950s; it does not start at 8.
The dotted line ends near 0 in 2018, not around 6.
The description does not mention that the figure contains both a solid blue line and a blue dotted trend line.
